description:
About the company
 Our client is a software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Join as an early engineer to build backend services, data pipelines and LLM-powered features from the ground up. You will make key architecture decisions, own production quality for AI systems, and help shape the technical direction of a small, growing team.
 What you'll do
 - Design and build core backend services that take documents from ingestion through to sourced, AI-generated answers.
 - Own a multi-provider LLM gateway, including caching, request replay and model routing guided by evaluation results.
 - Work closely with leadership and engineers on client deployments, turning repeated patterns into reusable platform features.
 - Build extraction pipelines and semantic matching for messy, unstructured financial documents, with controls against fabricated output.
 - Lead the design of a multi-tenant data and retrieval layer, along with governance features such as policy checks, human escalation and audit logging.
 - Build reusable integrations with third-party business software to speed up deployments and add platform value.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 5+ years of backend engineering experience.
 - A hands-on history of putting language-model functionality into live products used by customers, weighing quality, speed and spend, and managing unreliable generated responses.
 - Ability to create foundational systems with no existing groundwork, making technical design decisions when priorities are unsettled.
 - Proficiency in building server-side software and hosted environments, with a JavaScript-based server language or a relational database as an advantage.
 - Experience designing and building a platform or major system end to end, or leading one on a small team.
 - Experience building evaluations and guardrails against hallucinations and bad outputs.
 - Experience working with sensitive enterprise data.
 - An applied AI, machine learning or full-stack background with real production AI work, beyond chatbots or prototypes.
 Bonus points
 - Familiarity with systems for parsing text-heavy files, graph-based data stores, or centralized model-access services.
 - Financial or property document literacy.
 - Fine-tuning or computer vision experience.
 - Background at small, young companies, with a preference for having been one of the first engineers on a team.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: $150K to $240K
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - Chicago, IL, United States
 - Hybrid
 - Full-time
